The SiriusXM-ready audio system with nine speakers delivers quality sound, and Bluetooth connectivity manages your calls and streaming audio effortlessly. Adaptive cruise control reduces fatigue on highway drives by maintaining your set speed automatically.

Safety and convenience features work together to protect your investment. The backup camera, parking sensors, and auto-dimming rear-view mirror assist with visibility and maneuvering. Electronic stability control, traction control, and a comprehensive airbag system provide confidence on any road condition. Weather-appropriate features like the all-weather floor liners and tri-fold tonneau cover protect your truck's interior and cargo area.

The 8-speed automatic transmission shifts seamlessly, and the 4WD system stands ready for whatever terrain lies ahead. The truck's silver exterior presents a clean, professional appearance that complements both job sites and suburban driveways.

Inside, the cabin reflects Ram's commitment to driver comfort and connectivity. The Uconnect 5 navigation system features an expansive 12-inch touchscreen with seamless smartphone integration through Apple CarPlay and Google Android Auto. Nine amplified speakers with subwoofer deliver rich sound, while SiriusXM 360L keeps you entertained throughout your journey. Heated front seats and a heated steering wheel ensure comfort during winter months, and dual-zone automatic climate control lets you and your passenger set individual temperature preferences.

Practical features enhance both work and weekend capability. The rear power sliding window facilitates easy access to the truck bed, while the remote tailgate release adds convenience when your hands are full. A spray-in bedliner protects your cargo area, and pick-up box lighting illuminates your work after dark. Four adjustable cargo tie-down hooks keep loads secure, and the 400W inverter powers tools and devices directly from the truck's electrical system.

The Big Horn Level 2 Equipment Group and Sport Appearance Package combine to create a truck that looks and performs like a premium offering. Power-adjustable pedals and an 8-way power driver seat with lumbar support ensure you find the perfect driving position, while the leather-wrapped steering wheel adds a touch of refinement. Auto power-folding mirrors and an auto-dimming exterior driver mirror simplify your daily routine, and the universal garage door opener keeps your hands free as you arrive home.

We deliver anywhere, giving you flexibility with your purchase. This 2025 Ram 1500 Big Horn/Lone Star represents a rare combination of capability, comfort, and value. Come experience it in person and discover why this truck deserves space in your driveway.

This 2016 Mazda CX-9 Grand Touring combines practicality, comfort, and reliability in a three-row SUV that's ready to serve your family's needs.

- 12 Speakers with Bose Audio System
- SiriusXM Satellite Radio
- Navigation System
- Heads-Up Display
- Power Moonroof
- Heated Front Bucket Seats with Leather Trim
- Power Driver and Passenger Seats with Memory
- Automatic Temperature Control with Dual Front and Rear Zones
- Lane Departure Warning System
- Rear Parking Sensors with Exterior Camera
- All-Wheel Drive with 2.5L 4-Cylinder Engine
- 20" Aluminum Alloy Wheels
- 4-Wheel Disc Brakes with ABS
- Electronic Stability Control
- Roof Rack with Rails

The CX-9 Grand Touring is finished in attractive blue that maintains its appearance well. With just over 53,000 miles on the odometer, this three-row SUV remains in solid condition with considerable life ahead. The 2.5L 4-cylinder engine paired with the 6-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive delivers practical performance for daily driving, returning 21 miles per gallon in the city and 27 on the highway.

Interior comfort is a priority in this model. The front bucket seats feature leather trim and heating capability, so you and your passenger enjoy warmth on cold mornings. Memory seating for the driver allows quick adjustment to your preferred position each time you enter. Climate control reaches all three rows through automatic temperature management and rear air conditioning, ensuring every passenger stays comfortable regardless of season or seating location.

Technology integrates seamlessly into your daily routine. The navigation system provides reliable routing, while the Heads-Up Display keeps important information visible without requiring you to look away from the road. The Bose audio system with 12 speakers fills the cabin with clear, quality sound whether you're listening to SiriusXM satellite radio, AM/FM broadcasts, or streaming services like Pandora and Aha. Voice command functionality lets you control functions safely while driving, and standard HomeLink garage door integration adds convenience to daily use.

Safety features give you added confidence on every trip. Lane Departure Warning alerts you if you drift from your lane, while the rearview camera and rear parking sensors assist with backing up safely. Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control work actively to maintain grip and stability, supported by four-wheel independent suspension tuned for smooth, controlled driving.

Practical touches enhance everyday ownership. The power liftgate makes loading cargo effortless, and the split folding rear seat adapts to your cargo and passenger needs. The roof rack with rails accommodates additional storage options, and rain-sensing wipers automatically adjust to weather conditions. Remote keyless entry, illuminated entry lighting, and compass/outside temperature display round out the thoughtful feature set.

The 6.7L turbocharged diesel engine delivers commanding power while the 10-speed automatic ensures smooth transitions across any workload. The FX4 Off-Road Package equips this truck with Hill Descent Control, specifically tuned suspension components, and protective skid plates-features that extend capability beyond standard operation. Four-wheel drive with electronic shift-on-the-fly keeps this F-450 ready for demanding terrain or challenging weather conditions.

Inside, the Platinum trim elevates the experience with dual-zone climate control, heated and ventilated front seats, and a heated steering wheel that responds to winter conditions. The Rapid-Heat Supplemental Cab Heater ensures quick warmth during cold starts. The twin panel power moonroof floods the cabin with natural light, while the B&O Unleashed Sound System transforms your daily commute or long hauls into an audio experience. SYNC 4 with enhanced voice recognition puts navigation, communication, and entertainment within voice command reach.

Safety and visibility command attention throughout the design. Dual front impact airbags, front side impact airbags, and an overhead airbag work together with electronic stability control and ABS brakes to protect occupants. Exterior parking camera, auto high-beam headlights, and front fog lights enhance awareness in all driving conditions. The comprehensive sensor suite keeps you informed and in control.

The 14,000 lb GVWR Payload Package and dual rear wheels establish this truck's heavy-duty foundation, while the 19.5" forged polished aluminum wheels provide both strength and visual presence. Front wheel well liners come pre-installed to protect against road debris.

At 19,390 miles, this truck represents a lightly used opportunity to own a fully equipped F-450SD without compromise. The combination of diesel efficiency, premium amenities, and off-road readiness creates a vehicle suited for work, adventure, and everyday driving.

We invite you to experience this truck firsthand and discuss how it meets your specific needs.

Speed-sensing steering and performance traction management work in concert to provide responsive, controlled handling in demanding driving situations.Climate control throughout the cabin is managed by front dual-zone automatic temperature regulation and rear window defrosting, ensuring comfort for all occupants regardless of season. The comprehensive safety suite includes dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, occupant sensing technology, and emergency communication through OnStar and Chevrolet connected services, providing peace of mind with every drive.Every detail of this Grand Sport reflects meticulous attention to design and function. The Santorini blue seat belt color coordinates with the Admiral Blue heritage graphics and hash marks, creating visual harmony throughout the exterior. Step into flagship-level luxury and capability with this 2025 Lincoln Navigator Black Label, finished in Pristine White Metallic Tri-Coat. A CARFAX One-Owner vehicle with a clean history, strong service record, and Factory Certified status, this Navigator represents Lincoln s highest trim level built for executive comfort, long-distance travel, and serious towing capability.

Powered by a twin-turbocharged 3.5L V6 paired with a 10-speed automatic and intelligent 4WD system, it delivers effortless acceleration and confident highway cruising while maintaining composure under load thanks to adaptive suspension and advanced drive modes.

Inside, the Black Label cabin is the defining feature. The Enlighten theme surrounds occupants in premium opulence leather captain s chairs with heating, ventilation, and massage-level comfort features. Both front and rear passengers benefit from heated and ventilated seating, while memory functions and power adjustments ensure tailored comfort for multiple drivers. A panoramic Vista Roof enhances cabin openness, and ambient lighting elevates nighttime ambiance.

Technology is fully integrated and high-end. A 28-speaker Revel Ultima 3D audio system delivers reference-grade sound staging. Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, wireless charging, and Lincoln s connected navigation system provide seamless digital integration. The 12-inch+ digital displays and head-up display keep critical driving information immediately accessible without distraction.

Driver assistance systems are comprehensive: adaptive cruise control, lane assist, blind spot monitoring with rear cross-traffic alert, 360-degree camera system, front and rear parking sensors, and trailer assist features including sway control and integrated towing guidance. This is a genuinely confident long-distance towing platform as much as it is a luxury cruiser.

Exterior design emphasizes presence and functionality. Adaptive LED headlamps, illuminated power-deploying running boards, 22-inch high-gloss ebony wheels, and power-folding mirrors reinforce its flagship status. A hands-free power liftgate and panoramic roof complete the utility-meets-luxury balance.

As a Lincoln Signature Certified vehicle, it has undergone a 200-point inspection and includes a 72-month/100,000-mile limited warranty from the original in-service date, along with roadside assistance, trip interruption coverage, and a transferable warranty ensuring long-term ownership confidence.

You also benefit from dealership protections including a 5-day return and 30-day exchange policy, plus the Auto Rewards Program with service incentives and additional ownership perks.

This 2025 Lincoln Navigator Black Label stands at the top of the full-size luxury SUV segment combining high-output capability, first-class interior execution, and advanced driver technology in a single flagship platform.

The Platinum Plus interior elevates the cabin experience with premium suede-wrapped pillars, premium leather interior grab handles, and an upgraded floor mat design that complements the luxury theme throughout. Navigation guidance, automatic headlights with delay-off function, and rain-sensing wipers enhance daily usability and safety.

Beyond the cabin, the gray exterior presents a professional appearance, complemented by body-color bumpers, satin chrome door handles, and a unique satin-finish grille with bright chrome inserts. The 20 wheels showcase meticulous detailing that reflects the Platinum designation throughout the truck.

This F-250SD Platinum combines heavy-duty capability with genuine luxury appointments for drivers who refuse to compromise on either performance or comfort. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience the commanding presence and refined interior quality this truck delivers.

Technology features include a 10-inch navigation system with Apple CarPlay®, Bluetooth® connectivity, Adaptive Cruise Control, a 360-degree camera, front and rear parking sensors, power-folding heated mirrors, and a 12-inch digital instrument cluster. Advanced safety systems include Autonomous Emergency Braking, Lane Keep Assist, Lane Departure Warning, Blind Spot Warning, and Electronic Stability Control.

Combining bespoke luxury, exceptional V8 performance, advanced technology, and an extensive list of premium factory options, this Aston Martin DBX is an outstanding luxury SUV that delivers both grand touring comfort and unmistakable Aston Martin character.
